COMPANY PROFILE

Established in 1976, Kangaroo Plastics is one of the largest and most advanced integrated manufacturing
plants in the Middle East. The company is ISO 9001:2008 certified and is equipped with state-of-the-art,
European machines for processing, printing and producing a wide range of polymer-based films and flexible
packaging materials for industrial, commercial, food and pharmaceutical applications.

Kangaroo Plastics boasts a multiple blown film extrusion line from Italian manufacturer Bandera, laminators
from DCM, bag making and film pouching machines, cast extrusion lines for cable tiles along with a host of
other equipment and accessories.

The company is equipped with a flexo prepress department, a CDI plate imager as well as a large graphic
arts department. The modern in-house quality control department ensures products are tested for strict
adherence to technical parameters and international standards. manner that products pass through all
stages of manufacturing, right from incoming raw materials to final dispatch, in accordance with predefined
standards of quality. This ensures final products meet customers' expectations both in terms of quality and
timely delivery. Even though polyethylene is the most common film used at Kangaroo Plastics, other films
such as PVC, BOPP and nylon are also used to produce a wide range of packaging products.

Kangaroo Plastics offers a wide range of packaging materials used in various industries, including
construction, agriculture, food and beverages, retail and FMCG and industrial supplies.

CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY

CONSTRUCTION ROLLS: Construction industry are exceptionally strong with very good mechanical properties
for heavy duty outdoor applications. The rolls are made up of polyethylene sheets with a maximum
thickness of 0.6mm or 600 microns and a maximum width of 7.5 meters.

DETECTABLE & NON-DETECTABLE CAUTION TAPES: Our printed caution tapes are ideal for magnetic
detection and identification of underground utility service lines, such as water, sewage and drainage pipes.
The width of tape used is determined by the size and depth of the utility line.

BARRIER TAPES: Our range of barrier tapes are ideal for businesses requiring an easy to use product to
identify hazards. The tapes can be printed as per customers’ requirements.

CABLE TILES: The HDPE cable tiles we manufacture are used as a protective shield for underground electrical
cables and offer high tensile strength as well as high impact and puncture resistance.

DUCTILE IRON SLEEVES: The anti-corrosion sleeves for ductile iron pipes come in blue or black colors and a
standard thickness of 200 -500 microns.

PALLET COVERS
The pallet covers we manufacture are stretch, heat shrinkable and UV treated. They are ideal to cover
pallets carrying chemicals and oils.

LAMINATION GRADE FILM
Constructed from a clear blend of high clarity LDPE and LLDPE, our lamination grade films are ideal for use
as a sealant web thanks to their enhanced clarity, seal response and physical strength.

MULTI-LAYER POLYETHYLENE TUBES
The excellent moisture, low temperature resistance and dimensional stability offered by our multi-layer
tubes make them ideal for packaging mincemeat and other industrial products.

POUCHES
We manufacture double and triple laminated pouches for packaging dry fruits, pickles, coffee, tea, dates,
pasta and rice.

SHOPPING BAGS
We manufacture and supply superior quality line or process printed shopping bags for the retail sector.

COURIER BAGS
The multi-layer, printed courier bags come with permanent, resealable, perforated flaps and consecutive
numbering.

PILLOW BAGS
Our low-density pillow bags are ideal for packaging normal and vacuum pillows of different sizes.

DIAPER BAGS
Process printed bags with handles for packaging baby diaper bags and sanitary pads.
